# Issue #55: struct field defaults bind to their declaration scope, not
# the use site. Local shadowing must not change values or interface
# dynamic types, and cross-package consumers must resolve private names.
env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local
mkdir $WORK/bin

cd w
logos build ./...
logos build -o $WORK/bin/shadow$GOEXE ./l/cmd
exec $WORK/bin/shadow$GOEXE
stdout '^7 true \[7\] map\[n:7\]$'
stdout '^\[7\] map\[n:7\]$'
logos build -o $WORK/bin/xpkg$GOEXE ./g/cmd
exec $WORK/bin/xpkg$GOEXE
stdout '^port: 8080 kind: cfg.marker$'
stdout '^pair: 8080 8080$'
stdout '^db: 8080$'
stdout '^box: 8080$'
stdout '^elx: 8080$'
stdout '^elp: 8080$'
stdout '^names: 11 22$'
stdout '^gen: 8080$'
stdout '^coll: 3 5$'
stdout '^derived: 8080 8080 8080 8080 8080 8080$'
cd ..

-- w/go.work --
go 1.27

use (
	./l
	./g
)

-- w/l/go.mod --
module example.com/l

go 1.27

-- w/l/cfg/cfg.lgo --
package cfg

import "fmt"

const defaultPort = 8080

type marker int

type Config struct {
	Port  int = defaultPort
	Value any = marker(defaultPort)
	Items []int = []int{defaultPort}
}

type Pair struct {
	P, Q int = defaultPort
}

type DB Config

type Box[T any] struct {
	Port int = defaultPort
}

type A_B struct {
	C int = 11
}

type A struct {
	B_C int = 22
}

type G[T any] Config

// A defined type over a generic instantiation still records defaults;
// the owner arguments come from this declaration, not the literal's.
type DbBox Box[string]

type Derived[T any] Box[T]

type Args2[A, B any] struct {
	A A
	B B
}

// A nested instantiation exercises bracket recovery in the derived args.
type Nested Box[Args2[int, string]]

func DerivedPort() int {
	defaultPort := 5
	d := Derived[int]{}
	_ = defaultPort
	return d.Port
}

func DbBoxPort() int {
	h := DbBox{}
	return h.Port
}

type Braced Box[struct{ A int }]

// A brace inside a struct tag must not corrupt the arg recovery.
type Tagged Box[struct {
	A int `json:"{"`
}]

func NestedPort() int {
	n := Nested{}
	return n.Port
}

func BracedPort() int {
	b := Braced{}
	return b.Port
}

func TaggedPort() int {
	t := Tagged{}
	return t.Port
}

func LogosDefault_Solo__F() int { return 5 }

type Solo struct {
	F int = 3
}

func Kind() string {
	c := Config{}
	return fmt.Sprintf("%T", c.Value)
}

func Elided() int {
	s := []Config{{}}
	return s[0].Port
}

func IntBoxPort() int {
	type IntBox Box[int]
	return (IntBox{}).Port
}

-- w/l/cmd/main.lgo --
package main

import (
	"fmt"
)

const seed = 7

type marker int

type Local struct {
	Scalar int            = seed
	Value  any            = marker(seed)
	Items  []int          = []int{seed}
	Index  map[string]int = map[string]int{"n": seed}
}

func original(v any) bool {
	_, ok := v.(marker)
	return ok
}

func main() {
	seed := 99
	type marker string
	_ = seed
	a, b := Local{}, Local{}
	fmt.Println(a.Scalar, original(a.Value), a.Items, a.Index)
	a.Items[0] = 0
	a.Index["n"] = 0
	fmt.Println(b.Items, b.Index)
}

-- w/g/go.mod --
module example.com/g

go 1.27

-- w/g/cmd/main.lgo --
package main

import (
	"fmt"

	"example.com/l/cfg"
)

func main() {
	c := cfg.Config{}
	fmt.Printf("port: %d kind: %T\n", c.Port, c.Value)
	p := cfg.Pair{}
	fmt.Println("pair:", p.P, p.Q)
	d := cfg.DB{}
	fmt.Println("db:", d.Port)
	bx := cfg.Box[int]{}
	fmt.Println("box:", bx.Port)
	el := []cfg.Config{{}}
	fmt.Println("elx:", el[0].Port)
	fmt.Println("elp:", cfg.Elided())
	fmt.Println("names:", cfg.A_B{}.C, cfg.A{}.B_C)
	g := cfg.G[int]{}
	fmt.Println("gen:", g.Port)
	fmt.Println("coll:", cfg.Solo{}.F, cfg.LogosDefault_Solo__F())
	fmt.Println("derived:", cfg.DerivedPort(), cfg.DbBoxPort(), cfg.IntBoxPort(), cfg.NestedPort(), cfg.BracedPort(), cfg.TaggedPort())
}
